blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Tracking objects through transformations is essential for understanding real-world dynamics. Recent work has extended traditional object tracking to detect state changes. However, existing methods require an initial object prompt and detect only its decompositions, missing assembly events, which begin with multiple objects rather than one. We therefore introduce a prompt-free formulation of this task, where the goal is to recover all object tracks and detect both decomposition and assembly events given only a video. Our key insight is that assembly is decomposition in reverse. Building on this insight, we present Atlas, a zero-shot system that constructs and jointly reasons over forward and reverse spatiotemporal partitions to recover object tracks and their transformations. We further introduce OmniST, a benchmark with dense annotations of objects and both transformation types. On OmniST, Atlas recovers more than twice as many state changes as prior methods while remaining competitive on existing benchmarks that only evaluate decomposition.
blocks.zh: 通过转化跟踪物体对了解现实世界动态至关重要。 最近的工作将传统的对象跟踪扩展为检测状态变化. 然而,现有的方法需要初始对象即时检测,并只检测其分解,缺失的组装事件,这些组装事件开始于多个对象而不是一个. 因此,我们对这项任务采用了一种迅速免费的提法,其目标是恢复所有物体轨道,并探测只有一段录像的分解和组装事件。 我们的主要见解是,组装正在逆向分解。 在这个洞察力的基础上,我们提出了Atlas系统,这是一个零射线系统,它构建并联合了前向和反向的瞬间分区,以恢复物体轨道及其变换。 我们进一步引入了OmniST,这个基准对物体和两种变换类型都有密集的说明. 在OmniST上,阿特拉斯恢复了比先前方法多一倍多的状态变化,同时仍然对仅评价分解情况的现有基准有竞争力.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Object transformations are everywhere: a chef slices a tomato; a child assembles a toy; a caterpillar becomes a chrysalis and later emerges as a butterfly. Understanding these changes is crucial, whether for reasoning about pre- and post-conditions of actions by embodied agents [ 20 , 28 ] , monitoring wildlife across developmental stages, or creating policy sub-goals from recorded demonstrations [ 15 ] .
blocks.zh: 物体变相随处可见:厨师切出一朵番茄;孩子组装出一朵玩具;毛毛虫会变成一朵克丽萨利而后以蝴蝶相出. 了解这些变化至关重要,无论是对体现的代理人[20、28]采取行动的前后条件进行推理,对各个发展阶段的野生生物进行监测,还是通过有记录的演示制定政策次级目标[15]。

blocks.en: One approach is to ask a multimodal language model (MLLM) to identify transformations in a video [ 1 , 33 ] . Unfortunately, MLLMs provide only coarse descriptions of what occurred. Mounting evidence suggests that current MLLMs struggle to spatiotemporally ground temporal events in videos [ 9 , 43 ] . This lack of grounding is problematic: e.g., it prevents embodied agents from tying transformations (“a boy building a toy”) to the specific objects and context (the particular pieces and how they go together).
blocks.zh: 一种方法是要求一种多式语言模型(MLLM)在视频中识别变换[1,33]. 遗憾的是,MLLMs只粗略地描述了所发生的情况。 不断涌现的证据表明,目前的MLLMs为在视频中快速平息时间事件而挣扎 [9,43]. 这种缺乏地基存在问题:例如,它阻止了体现的物剂将转化(“男孩造玩具”)与特定物体和上下文(特定碎片和它们如何结合在一起)挂钩。

blocks.en: To ground transformations in the video, one must also track the objects involved. Recently, Sun et al. [ 31 ] extended traditional object tracking to detect state transformations as well. Their approach, TubeletGraph, takes a video and an initial target object mask as input, tracks the object through its transformations, and produces a state graph that records each transformation along with its timing, participating objects, and natural-language description.
blocks.zh: 要在视频中进行地面变换,还必须跟踪所涉及的物体。 最近,孙等. [31] 扩展了传统的物体跟踪,也探测到状态变换. 他们的方法"TubeletGraph"以视频和初始目标对象口罩作为输入,通过它的变换来跟踪对象,并生成一个状态图,记录每个变换及其时间,参与对象,以及自然语言描述.

blocks.en: However, this formulation has a critical flaw. Like traditional object tracking, the problem is formulated as tracking a single object annotated in the first frame. This limits TubeletGraph [ 31 ] and other current systems [ 30 ] to decomposition events, where the tracked object fragments into independently trackable parts. When the reverse occurs—multiple objects merging during assembly—these systems simply fail to detect the event, either silently ending the track or continuing it through the assembled object, resulting in incomplete and misleading output. Beyond assembly, current systems also miss any further decompositions of the fragments from an earlier decomposition since they only reason about the transformations of the original prompted object. For example, in Figure 1 , TubeletGraph detects the removal of the bag from the box, but misses the subsequent decomposition (removing crackers from the bag) and assembly (inserting the bag back into the box).
blocks.zh: 然而,这种提法存在严重缺陷。 与传统对象跟踪一样,问题被表述为跟踪第一个框架中被注释的单个对象. 这限制了TubeletGraph [31] 和其他当前系统 [30] 分解事件,其中被跟踪的物体碎片会分解为可独立追踪的部分. 当反向发生时——在组装过程中多个对象合并——这些系统根本无法探测到事件,要么静静地结束轨道,要么通过组装对象继续轨道,导致输出不全和误导. 除组装外,电流系统还漏掉了从更早分解出来的碎片的任何再分解,因为它们只是原始被激发物体变相的原因. 例如在图1中,TubeletGraph检测出从盒子中取出袋子,但错过了之后的分解(从袋子中取出快克)和组装(将袋子放回盒子中).

blocks.en: To truly track any transformation, we must relax the traditional tracking assumption of a single “prompt” object and instead account for all objects in the scene. Concretely, given only a video, the goal is to produce a spatiotemporal state graph recording every decomposition and assembly along with its timing, participating objects, and natural-language description. This increases task difficulty, as one must now search for all objects that may undergo a state change without any prompt to anchor the search.
blocks.zh: 为了真正追踪任何变相,我们必须放松传统的追踪假设,即一个单一的“即时”物体,而代之以记录现场的所有物体。 具体地说,只给一个视频,目标是制作一个相片状态图,记录每一个分解和组装及其时间,参与对象,以及自然语言描述. 这增加了任务难度,因为人们现在必须搜索所有可能发生状态变化的对象,而无需立即锁定搜索。

blocks.en: To solve this, we present Atlas ( A ll-object T racking and L ocalization A cross S tate changes), a zero-shot framework for prompt-free tracking and understanding of object transformations. Our key insight is that assembly is decomposition in reverse : a video of objects merging is, up to temporal direction, indistinguishable from one in which an object splits. Based on this insight, Atlas constructs forward and reverse spatiotemporal partitions and jointly reasons across them using spatial relationships to recover state changes. Atlas then uses a VLM to verify each candidate transformation, refine its timing, and describe the transformation. The name Atlas also describes the output: a temporal atlas in which, for any object at any time, one can retrieve its segmentation mask and the transformation subgraph leading to and following from its current state.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这个问题,我们提出了阿特拉斯(A ll-object T racking and L ocalization A cross S tate changes),这是一个用于快速免费跟踪和理解物体变换的零镜头框架. 我们的关键见解是, 组装是逆向分解的: 一个物体合并的视频, 直至时间方向, 与一个物体分裂的视频无法区分。 基于这一见解,阿特拉斯构建了前向和倒向的spatiotopal分割并共同使用了空间关系来恢复状态变化. Atlas然后使用VLM来验证每个候选变换,完善其时间,并描述变换. 名称"阿特拉斯"(Atlas)也描述了输出:一个时间地图集,对于任何物体,人们可以在任何时候取回其分解口罩和导致并遵循其当前状态的变换子图.

blocks.en: For evaluation, existing benchmarks such as VOST [ 34 ] are also limited to decomposition events: assembly events, which start from multiple objects instead of one prompt object, are not even annotated in the data. We therefore create a new benchmark OmniST with annotated object tracks and both decomposition and assembly events. On OmniST , we find that Atlas recovers more than twice as many state changes as prior methods. At the same time, we maintain competitive performance on previous benchmarks that only evaluate decomposition [ 34 ] .
blocks.zh: 对于评价,VOST [34]等现有基准也仅限于分解事件:集合事件,从多个对象开始,而不是从一个快对象开始,数据中甚至没有注释. 因此,我们创造了一个新的基准OmniST,上面有附加注释的物体轨道以及分解和组装事件. 在OmniST上,我们发现阿特拉斯恢复的状态变化是先前方法的两倍多. 同时,我们保持以往仅评价分解情况的基准的竞争性业绩。

blocks.en: In sum, the contributions of our work are: 1. We introduce the task of tracking all objects and detecting their transformations given only a video. 2. We propose Atlas , a zero-shot framework that requires no initial prompt, constructs bidirectional spatiotemporal partitions, and models assembly as the temporal reverse of decomposition. 3. We introduce OmniST , a benchmark with decomposition and assembly events, and demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on OmniST while matching prior art on existing benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 总之,我们工作的贡献是: 1. 我们提出一项任务,即对所有物体进行跟踪,并检测其仅录相的变相。 2. 我们提议阿特拉斯系统,这是一个零镜头框架,不需要初步迅速,它构建了双向瞬间分接,模型组装是分解的时间倒置。 3. 我们采用OmniST,这是分解和组装活动的基准,并展示OmniST上的最新业绩,同时将先前的艺术与现有基准相匹配。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Object Tracking and Transformation Understanding. Object tracking methods [ 16 ] typically segment a target object specified by an initial mask and propagate it forward via appearance features [ 2 , 3 , 14 , 8 , 25 , 6 ] . SAM2 [ 27 ] substantially advances this paradigm with a streaming memory-attention mechanism. Extensions such as SAM2Long [ 11 ] , SAMURAI [ 39 ] , and DAM4SAM [ 35 ] address error accumulation, crowded scenes, and visual distractors. However, under dramatic visual changes, these trackers lose the target object. Datasets such as VOST [ 34 ] , VSCOS [ 41 ] , DTTO [ 37 ] , and M 3 -VOS [ 5 ] benchmark this challenge. Re-VOS [ 5 ] proposes combining forward and backward memory to improve robustness through transformations, while recent approaches improve SAM2 during state transformations, but require training [ 10 ] . However, these methods do not recover the transformations themselves. TubeletGraph [ 31 ] extends object tracking by introducing Track Any State: given an initial mask, it recovers objects missed after decomposition via a spatiotemporal partition and constructs a state graph through VLM reasoning. Our work directly builds on Track Any State, but removes the initial prompt requirement and extends the framework to handle assembly transformations.
blocks.zh: 物体跟踪与变换理解. 物体跟踪方法 [16] 通常将初始口罩所指定的目标物体分出,并通过外观特征向上传播[2,3,14,8,25,6]. SAM2[27]以流传的内存留念机制大大地推进了这个范式. SAM2Long [11], SAMURAI [39], DAM4SAM [35] 等扩展处理错误堆积,拥挤的场景,和视觉分心器等. 然而,在戏剧性的视觉变化下,这些跟踪器失去了目标对象. 例如VOST [34],VSCOS [41],DTTO [37],M 3 -VOS [5]等数据集都以此为挑战基准. Re-VOS [5]建议将前向记忆和后向记忆结合起来,以通过转型来提高稳健性,而最近的方法在状态转型期间会改善SAM2,但需要培训 [10]. 然而,这些方法并没有恢复转型本身. TubeletGraph [31] 通过引入扩展对象跟踪 音轨 任何国家:给一个初始口罩,它通过分解分解后会恢复丢失的物体,并通过VLM推理构造一个状态图. 我们的工作直接建立在任何国家的轨道上,但取消了最初的即时要求并扩大了处理组装转换的框架。

blocks.en: Beyond prompt-based tracking, prompt-free and panoptic video segmentation methods [ 18 , 7 , 40 ] track all objects in a scene simultaneously without a per-object prompt. However, these methods do not model transformations: splits and merges are treated as the appearance of new objects rather than state change events. Our method is the first to combine prompt-free all-object tracking with transformation understanding.
blocks.zh: 除了快速跟踪之外,快速无光和泛光视频分解方法[18,7,40]同时跟踪一个场景中的所有物体,没有每个物体的提示. 然而,这些方法并没有模型化的转换:分出和合并被作为新对象的外观而不是状态变化事件来对待. 我们的方法是第一种将快速自由的全物体跟踪与变换理解相结合的方法.

blocks.en: Object State Change Recognition. A complementary line of work studies object state changes without maintaining persistent object tracks. HowToChange [ 38 ] and WhereToChange [ 24 ] train models to temporally and spatially localize three stages of a state change (initial, transitioning, and end) in instructional videos, using pseudo-labels from off-the-shelf vision-language systems. SPARTA [ 23 ] demonstrates robotic manipulation capabilities built upon spatially-progressing state change segmentation. While these methods produce spatially grounded outputs at the progress level, they do not maintain consistent object identities across transformation boundaries. In contrast, our method produces persistent spatiotemporal tracks that can be queried after the fact for any object at any time.
blocks.zh: 对象国变更识别. 互补的工作行研究对象状态变化而不保持持续的对象轨道. HowToChange [38]和WhereToCchange [24] 列车模型在教学视频中将状态变化的三个阶段(初始,过渡,和结束)在时间和空间上定位,使用现成的视觉语言系统的伪标签. SPARTA [23] 展示了基于空间进展状态变化分解的机器人操纵能力. 虽然这些方法在进步一级产生空间上的基础产出,但它们无法保持跨越变换边界的一致物体特性。 与此相反,我们的方法产生持久的spatiotemporal音轨,可以随时在任何物体的事实发生后询问.

blocks.en: Vision and Language. MLLMs such as GPT-4 [ 1 ] and Gemini [ 33 ] can reason about visual and textual queries [ 22 , 12 , 36 , 13 , 32 ] , but lack pixel-level grounding and produce only coarse event-level descriptions. In our work, we use VLMs to verify, refine, and describe the state changes identified through spatiotemporal reasoning over tubelets.
blocks.zh: 远景与语言. GPT-4 [1]和双子座 [33]等MLLMs可以解释视觉和文字查询[22,12,36,13,32],但缺乏像素级地平分,只产生粗糙的事件级描述. 在我们的工作中,我们使用VLM来验证,精炼,并描述通过对管子的瞬间推理而确定的状态变化.

blocks.en: 3.2 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 3.2 初步情况

blocks.en: We build on the observation in TubeletGraph [ 31 ] that the decomposition of an object results in the appearance of new tracks. For example, in Figure 1 (top), when the bag is removed from the box (the prompt object), the tracker [ 27 ] follows the box, leaving the bag untracked. TubeletGraph initializes a new track for this untracked region and reasons about its relation to the prompt object to identify the transformation. However, TubeletGraph cannot detect assembly, as assembly does not trigger the appearance of new tracks during forward tracking.
blocks.zh: 我们在TubeletGraph [31] 的观察的基础上认为,一个物体的分解导致出出出出新的轨道. 例如,在图1 (top)中,当将包从盒子中取出(即时对象)时,跟踪器[27]跟随盒子,使包没有被跟踪. 管头 图表初始化了这个未跟踪区域的新音轨,以及它与快速对象的关系以识别变换的原因. 不过,管子 图形无法检测组装,因为组装不会在前向跟踪过程中触发出新轨道.

blocks.en: Since assembly is decomposition in reverse, tracking backward allows assembly to be detected through the emergence of new tracks in the reverse direction. We therefore build spatiotemporal partitions [ 31 ] in both the forward and the backward directions. We then consider tracks that newly emerge in the middle of the video in either direction, and use both forward and reverse partitions to reason about whether these tracks are the signatures of decomposition or assembly events.

blocks.en: We construct the forward spatiotemporal partition of the video following TubeletGraph [ 31 ] : we segment every frame with CropFormer [ 26 ] , propagate every entity in the first frame forward with SAM2 [ 27 ] , and at each subsequent frame, initialize a new track for any entity whose area is covered by less than τ coverage \tau_{\text{coverage}} of existing tracks. blocks.en: At this point, the candidate transformations have two potential issues. First, our detected state changes may not represent actual state changes due to coincidental spatial overlap. Second, the detected frame t t may differ from the frame t true t_{\text{true}} at which the transformation actually occurs. In a decomposition, SAM2 [ 27 ] often keeps a single mask over the separating objects for several frames, so P F , i P_{F,i} emerges at some t > t true t>t_{\text{true}} . In reverse tracking, SAM2 keeps a single mask over the merged objects past the point where they separate in reverse time, so P R , i P_{R,i} emerges at some t < t true t<t_{\text{true}} . Thus, decompositions are often detected late and assemblies early.

blocks.en: We address both issues simultaneously with a VLM. Although a VLM cannot spatially ground transformations, we leverage it for semantic and temporal reasoning about candidate events. For each candidate transformation, we prompt the VLM with full frames sampled uniformly from the video. We then provide frames sampled around the predicted event, each cropped to the union of the participating objects’ bounding boxes with their contours overlaid. The full frames give context for the whole video, and the crops show the objects closely enough to verify the transformation and locate it in time. Based on this observation that decompositions are predicted late and assembly events are predicted early, we sample frames asymmetrically. For a suspected decomposition at t t , we sample frames from [ t − ω long , t + ω short ] [t-\omega_{\text{long}},t+\omega_{\text{short}}] where ω short < ω long \omega_{\text{short}}<\omega_{\text{long}} . For a suspected assembly at t t , we sample frames from [ t − ω short , t + ω long ] [t-\omega_{\text{short}},t+\omega_{\text{long}}] . We ask the VLM to determine whether a transformation actually occurred. If the VLM confirms a transformation, it outputs the frame at which separation first becomes visually apparent for decompositions or merging becomes visually complete for assembly events. The returned frame index is used as the final event time (Figure 3 ). The VLM also names the action and the objects involved in the pre- and post-transformation states, completing our state changes 𝒮 \mathcal{S} .

blocks.en: 3.6 Producing a Unified Spatiotemporal Partition
blocks.zh: 3.6 制作一个统一的空间分区

blocks.en: Once we have detected the state transformations, we proceed to produce a final, unified set of tubelets that form our spatiotemporal partition.
blocks.zh: 一旦我们探测到状态变换, 我们开始生产一个最终的, 统一的管子, 形成我们的分层。

blocks.en: We begin by identifying duplicate tubelets across the forward and reverse partitions 𝒫 F \mathcal{P}_{F} and 𝒫 R \mathcal{P}_{R} . For every pair ( P F , i , P R , j ) ∈ 𝒫 F × 𝒫 R (P_{F,i},P_{R,j})\in\mathcal{P}_{F}\times\mathcal{P}_{R} , we compute the video-level mean IoU over their temporal overlap. We then perform Hungarian matching [ 17 ] between forward and reverse tubelets, retaining matched pairs exceeding τ merge \tau_{\text{merge}} , along with the matches identified during transformation detection. For each matched pair, we take the union of their timestamps and masks, producing a single tubelet. We initialize our final set of tracks 𝒯 \mathcal{T} with these unified tubelets and update the pre- and post-tracks of each detected transformation to point to this set. We also add tracks involved in a transformation without a duplicate in the other direction to 𝒯 \mathcal{T} .
blocks.zh: 我们首先识别横跨前方的重复管并反向分割 P F\ mathcal{P}_{F}和 P R\mathcal{P}_{R} 。 每对 (P F, i, P R, j) → P F → P R (P_{F, i}, P_{R, j})\in\ mathcal{ P}_{F}\times\ mathcal{ P}_{R} ,我们计算视频级别 平均IoU 相对于时间重叠。 然后我们在前管和倒管之间执行匈牙利匹配[17],保留匹配的对子超过\ tau_{\text{commerce}}},以及转换检测中识别的匹配. 每对配对,我们用它们的时间戳和口罩结合,生产出一管管. 我们用这些统一的管来初始化我们最后一组T\ mathcal{T}的轨迹,并更新每个被检测到的变换的前后轨迹,以指向此套. 我们还在T\ mathcal{T}中添加了转换过程中没有重复的音轨。

blocks.en: Finally, we clean up the tracks 𝒯 \mathcal{T} both spatially and temporally. For each state change, guided by the VLM’s temporal alignment, we trim the tracks accordingly: for a decomposition predicted at frame t t , we enforce that the emergent object’s track begins at t t ; for an assembly predicted at frame t t , we enforce that the emergent track ends at t t . To prevent mask overlap, we subtract the emergent object’s mask from the source tubelet’s mask at each frame. To ensure complete spatiotemporal coverage, we add to the final pool any tubelet from either tracking direction that has neither been matched as a duplicate nor associated with a state change if less than τ area \tau_{\text{area}} of its area is already covered by tubelets in the pool. The final pool is a full spatiotemporal partition of the video.

Following TubeletGraph [ 31 ] , we additionally evaluate object tracking on VOST [ 34 ] , VSCOS [ 41 ] , and M 3 -VOS [ 5 ] , and transformation detection on VOST-TAS [ 31 ] .

blocks.en: Metrics. For object tracking on existing benchmarks, which contain only decomposition transformations, we follow VOST [ 34 ] and report Jaccard 𝒥 {\mathcal{J}} over the entire video and 𝒥 tr {\mathcal{J}}_{\mathrm{tr}} over the last 25% of frames, computed on the union of the masks of the prompt object and its resulting fragments. However, distinct objects combine during assembly, requiring tubelets to be evaluated individually. For object tracking on OmniST , we therefore construct a new tracking metric analogous to 𝒥 {\mathcal{J}} that evaluates individual tubelets. Since object identities may be ambiguous during transformations, we exclude frames within annotated transformation intervals and split ground-truth tracks into temporally stable tubelets at transformation boundaries. We similarly split predicted tracks at their predicted transformation boundaries. We then apply Hungarian matching [ 17 ] between predicted and ground-truth tubelets using mean IoU over all frames of the ground-truth tubelet. We report 𝒥 tubelet {\mathcal{J}}_{\text{tubelet}} , the average matched tubelet IoU over objects participating in transformations, with unmatched ground-truth tubelets assigned zero.
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 对于只包含分解变换的现有基准的物体跟踪,我们遵循VOST [34] ,并报告Jaccard J \ mathcal{J}} 在整段视频上,以及J tr \ mathcal{J}}_{\ mathrm{tr}} 在最后25%的帧上,计算出当事对象的口罩及其产生的碎片的结合. 然而,不同的物体在组装过程中结合,要求管子单独评估. 对于OmniST上的对象跟踪,我们因此构建了类似于J {\mathcal{J}}}的新跟踪度量衡,用来评价单个管子. 由于在变换过程中物体身份可能模糊不清,我们排除了附加说明的变换间隔内的帧,在变换边界上将地真道分割成时间稳定的管. 我们同样在预测的转化边界上 将预想的轨道分割开来。 然后,我们用平均IOU在预测的和地面真实的管子之间适用匈牙利语匹配[17] 。 我们报告 J 管子\ mathcal{J}}_{\text{tubelet}, 平均匹配的管子IoU 相对于参与变换的物体, 无匹配的地面真管指定为零 。

It then matches forward and reverse tracks via Hungarian matching [ 17 ] and merges matched pairs when their average per-frame IoU exceeds 0.75 0.75 . blocks.en: 5.3 Results on OmniST
blocks.zh: 5.3 关于OmniST的结果

blocks.en: Table 2 compares Atlas with all baselines on OmniST . Atlas achieves the highest object tracking score of 𝒥 tubelet = 68.7 {\mathcal{J}}_{\text{tubelet}}=68.7 , outperforming TubeletGraph [ 31 ] by 11.4 11.4 points.

blocks.en: For transformation detection, Atlas achieves the highest spatiotemporal and overall metrics. In particular, Atlas achieves over 2 × 2\times the overall recall ( ℋ \mathcal{H} ) of TubeletGraph-Bidir, improving from 16.2 16.2 to 36.1 36.1 , while achieving 4 × 4\times the overall precision ( ℋ P \mathcal{H}_{P} ), improving from 12.2 12.2 to 48.2 48.2 . A breakdown by transformation type in Appendix A.4 shows that Atlas improves overall recall over TubeletGraph-Bidir from 9.0 9.0 to 34.7 34.7 on assembly events and from 22.8 22.8 to 37.3 37.3 on decomposition events. Even applying our VLM stage to TubeletGraph-Bidir (+ Verif. & Realign.) closes only part of this gap, reaching ℋ = 23.2 \mathcal{H}=23.2 and ℋ P = 29.3 \mathcal{H}_{P}=29.3 . The remaining gap reflects the contribution of jointly reasoning over the two partitions, suggesting that running TubeletGraph independently in both directions is not enough.
blocks.zh: 对于转换检测,阿特拉斯系统实现了最高的瞬间和总体衡量标准。 特别是,阿特拉斯系统实现了TubeletGraph-Bidir的总召回(H\mathcal{H}),从16.2 16.2提高到36.1 36.1,同时实现了4×4%的总精度(H\mathcal{H}_{P}),从12.2 12.2提高到48.2 48.2。 附录A.4按变换类型分列显示,图贝莱特格拉夫-比迪尔的总体召回情况有所改善,组装活动从9.0起到34.7起,分解活动从22.8起到37.3起。 甚至将我们的 VLM 级应用到 TubeletGraph- Bidir (+ Verif. & Realign.) 。 仅关闭了这个缺口的一部分, 达到 H = 23. 2\ mathcal{H}=23.2 和 H P = 29.3\ mathcal{ H}_{P}=29.3. 所剩空白反映了联合推理对两个分区的贡献,说明双向独立运行TubeletGraph是不够的.

blocks.en: To understand where these gains come from, we analyze the transformations that Atlas recovers but TubeletGraph-Bidir misses. First, as discussed, TubeletGraph misses decompositions of fragments produced earlier in the video (e.g., crackers removed from a bag that was first taken out of its box). Atlas recovers 8 8 such decompositions in OmniST . Second, TubeletGraph accepts a new tubelet as a transformation product only if it satisfies both a spatial proximity prior and a semantic prior which requires high FC-CLIP [ 42 ] feature similarity between the new tubelet and the prompt object and often fails for assembly. In 13 13 transformations recovered by Atlas , TubeletGraph’s spatial proximity prior was satisfied but not its semantic prior (e.g., an SD card inserted into a camera, a pair of sunglasses inserted into an eyeglass case, a cleaning cloth removed from an eyeglass case).
blocks.zh: 为了了解这些收益来自何方,我们分析了阿特拉斯恢复但图贝莱特·格拉夫-比迪尔错过的转变. 首先,如上所讨论,TubeletGraph错过了视频中早些时候所出出碎片的分解(例如从被从盒子取出的一个袋子取出快克). Atlas在OmniST中恢复了8起这种分解. 第二,导管 图形只接受一个新的管件作为转化产物,条件是它既满足空间相近性,又满足语义相接性,这就要求高FC-CLIP[42]在新管件和快件之间具有相似性,而且往往无法组装。 在阿特拉斯公司回收的13个变相中,TubeletGraph之前的空间相近性是满意的,但之前的语义上不是满意的(例如,将一副自毁卡插入相机,将一对太阳镜插入一眼镜箱,从一眼镜箱取出一出清洁布)。

blocks.en: On the other hand, VLM-based baselines achieve the highest temporal localization and high semantic accuracy, demonstrating that a VLM can reliably identify what is happening and when. For temporal localization, VLM-based baselines outperform Atlas , which misses some transformations that do not result in new tubelets. However, GPT-4.1 + SAM3 yields only about a third of Atlas ’s spatiotemporal recall and overall recall ( ℋ S ​ T = 15.6 \mathcal{H}_{ST}=15.6 , ℋ = 11.3 \mathcal{H}=11.3 ), indicating that it struggles to localize the objects involved in transformations.
blocks.zh: 另一方面,基于VLM的基线实现了最高的时间定位和高语义精确度,表明VLM能够可靠地识别正在发生和何时发生. 就时间本地化而言,基于VLM的基线超过了Atlas,它错过了一些不会产生新管子的转变。 然而,GPT-4.1 + SAM3只产生阿特拉斯系统瞬间召回和总体召回的大约三分之一(HS T = 15.6\ mathcal{ H}_{ST}=15.6,H = 11.3\ mathcal{H}=11.3 ),表示其努力将所参与的变换对象本地化.

blocks.en: 5.4 Results on Benchmarks Without Assembly
blocks.zh: 5.4 关于无大会基准的结果

blocks.en: Even though VOST [ 34 ] , VSCOS [ 41 ] , and M 3 -VOS [ 5 ] do not capture assembly transformations, Table 3 shows that Atlas maintains tracking performance comparable to prompt-based methods on these benchmarks while being the only method that recovers both decomposition and assembly events.
blocks.zh: 尽管VOST [34],VSCOS [41],和M 3-VOS [5]没有捕捉到组装变换,但表3显示,Atlas保持的跟踪性能可以与这些基准的即时方法相媲美,同时是同时恢复分解和组装事件的唯一方法.

blocks.en: For transformation detection on VOST-TAS [ 31 ] , Atlas has the highest semantic verb and object accuracy, improving over TubeletGraph from 𝒮 V = 81.8 \mathcal{S}_{V}=81.8 to 89.5 89.5 and from 𝒮 O = 72.3 \mathcal{S}_{O}=72.3 to 97.3 97.3 . Since both methods use GPT-4.1 [ 1 ] , we attribute these gains to providing the VLM with additional temporal and spatial information through frames sampled throughout the video and around each emergence, unlike TubeletGraph, which reasons from only the initial frame and the emergence frame. Atlas also improves temporal precision from 43.1 43.1 to 51.4 51.4 , as it uses GPT-4.1 to reject false positives, while temporal recall decreases slightly from 20.4 20.4 to 17.6 17.6 , as verification may also filter valid transformations.
blocks.zh: 对于VOST-TAS [31]上的变换检测,阿特拉斯语有最高的语义动词和对象精度,比TubeletGraph从S V = 81.8\ mathcal{S}_{V}=81.8到89.5 89.5,从S O = 72.3\ mathcal{S}_{O}=72.3到97.3 97.3. 由于这两种方法都使用GPT-4.1 [1],我们将这些增益归因于通过整个视频和每次出现前后所取样的帧向VLM提供额外的时间和空间信息,这与TubeletGraph不同,TubeletGraph只是初始帧和出现帧的原因. 阿特拉斯还改进了时间精度,从43.1 43.1到51.4 51.4,因为它使用GPT-4.1来拒绝假阳性,而时间回放则从20.4 20.4到17.6 17.6略有减少,因为核查也可能过滤出有效的转换.

blocks.en: 5.5 Ablations
blocks.zh: 5.5 违约

blocks.en: We ablate the two uses of the VLM in Atlas (Table 4 ). Without verification, precision decreases substantially: 𝒯 P \mathcal{T}_{P} falls from 77.4 77.4 to 64.6 64.6 and ℋ P \mathcal{H}_{P} from 48.2 48.2 to 34.7 34.7 , while 𝒯 R \mathcal{T}_{R} rises slightly from 57.9 to 62.9. Verification trades a small amount of recall for the ability to filter out false positive transformations. Without realignment, both temporal precision and recall drop, reducing ℋ \mathcal{H} from 36.1 36.1 to 25.2 25.2 . Finally, disabling verification and realignment produces the largest degradation, reducing ℋ \mathcal{H} to 22.8 22.8 , demonstrating that VLM reasoning is essential for accurate transformation detection.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we introduce a prompt-free formulation of Track Any State, where the goal is to track all objects and detect their transformations. Since assembly is decomposition in reverse, we present Atlas , a zero-shot system that jointly reasons over forward and reverse spatiotemporal partitions to recover object tracks and construct a state graph. We also introduce OmniST , a benchmark with dense annotations of objects and both transformation types. On OmniST , Atlas more than doubles the overall recall of prior methods, while remaining competitive on benchmarks that annotate only decomposition.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们引入了 " 跟踪任何国家 " 的快速免费提法,其目标是跟踪所有物体并探测其变化。 由于组装是逆向分解的,我们呈现的是 Atlas,一个零射入的系统, 它联合了前向和逆向分解的理由,以恢复对象轨道并构建一个状态图。 我们还引入了 OmniST , 该基准对对象和两种变换类型都有密集的说明. 在OmniST上,阿特拉斯系统比以往方法的总体召回多一倍以上,同时在仅说明分解情况的基准上保持竞争力。

blocks.en: A.1 Defining transformations

blocks.en: A relevant question that readers might have is what we define as transformations. We frame this definition by looking to cognitive science. Classical models of object perception in cognitive science [ 29 ] identify objects as being cohesive ; i.e., the points on them form a connected surface at all times. We therefore consider transformations as events that break this property: either by causing sets of points to not be cohesive anymore (decomposition events) or by causing new sets of points to begin to move cohesively (assembly events).
blocks.zh: 一个读者可能有的相关问题是我们定义的转变. 我们从认知科学的角度来定义这个定义。 认知科学中物体感知的经典模型[29]将物体识别为有凝聚力;即它们上的各个点随时形成相通的表面. 因此,我们认为转变是打破这一属性的事件:要么是导致各组分不再具有凝聚力(分解事件),要么是导致新的各组分开始具有凝聚力地移动(组分事件).

blocks.en: Data Collection. We collect videos spanning household activities, cooking, and assembly tasks captured from both egocentric and third-person viewpoints with no jump cuts. The resulting dataset includes a broad range of actions such as removal, insertion, opening, closing, cutting, assembly, breaking, attachment, unscrewing, capping, pouring, scooping, peeling, connecting, splitting, and tearing. These actions are applied across diverse objects ranging from food items (e.g., oranges, pineapples, broccoli, peppers, eggs, pears) to household items (e.g., bottles, blenders, jars, sunglasses, toothbrushes, instruments), electronics (e.g., phones, earbuds, remotes, calculators, keyboards), furniture parts (e.g., chairs), and toys (e.g., LEGO bricks, train tracks, Play-Doh). Videos are sourced from: (1) recordings by the authors with an iPhone; (2) YouTube tutorials retrieved via action-object queries (e.g., “how to replace Swiffer mop pad”, “how to mount a car tire”); and (3) existing benchmarks including VOST [ 34 ] , VSCOS [ 41 ] , M 3 -VOS [ 5 ] , and IKEA Video Manuals [ 21 ] .

Initially, the prompt object is represented by the tubelet initialized from its first-frame mask. Following a detected decomposition, we track the resulting objects and output the union of their masks. A.6 Limitations
blocks.zh: A.6 限制

blocks.en:
Atlas detects a transformation only when a tubelet newly emerges in the
forward or reverse direction. Transformations that do not split or
merge objects, such as gradual in-place state changes (e.g., melting or
deformation), produce no new tubelets and are not detected. Moreover,
like TubeletGraph [ 31 ] , Atlas relies on the tracker’s
false negatives: the tracker must reliably fail to extend an existing mask over a transformation product for a new tubelet to emerge. Finally, constructing both a forward and a
reverse spatiotemporal partition is costly. However, the two partitions are fully independent and can be computed in parallel, and improvements in efficiency [ 30 ] directly reduce the cost of both.
